work.en: Old History biography of Luo Shaowei

translationRepairs: Wen set out wine for his mother, very merry, and speaking of family affairs said to her: "Zhu Five Classics toiled at Confucian learning yet never received a single appointment; now I have a son who is military commissioner—no disgrace to our forebears!"

Wen set out wine for his mother, very merry, and speaking of family affairs said to her: "Zhu Five Classics toiled at Confucian learning yet never received a single appointment; now there is a son who is military commissioner—no disgrace to our forebears!"

Focus speech 今有子為節度使 means Zhu Five Classics now has a son who is jiedushi (Wen of himself); the prior literal's "I have a son who is military commissioner" invents Wen as that son's father. Mother's reply in s0023 (汝致身及此) confirms Wen is the risen son. The proposed wording restores the correct kinship without new error.
